hero.title: Your records, as views people explore.
hero.lede: CanopyX draws tree grids, data grids, pivots, boards, plans, calendars, status matrices, change reviews and guided flows from your application's data. Write the view in C# and save a report that opens from disk, or mount the same runtime in your web app.

delivery.title: One HTML file
delivery.body: Data and runtime in a single page. Attach it to a ticket, archive it with a run, or open it from disk.

delivery.title: A folder on a file share
delivery.body: Branches, rows and search shards load from files beside the page, so 100,000 nodes open with no server.

delivery.title: Your own server
delivery.body: CanopyX.Data answers paging, filters, summaries and edits over IQueryable; CanopyX.AspNetCore serves the endpoints.

delivery.title: Mail, print and Word
delivery.body: The same view as a script-free table with inline styles that survive mail clients and paste into documents.

family.name: ChartForgeX
family.body: Charts, topology and report visuals rendered in .NET, for the pictures next to your tables.

family.name: HtmlForgeX
family.body: HTML reports and dashboards in C#. Its HtmlForgeX.CanopyX bridge hosts CanopyX views.

family.name: OfficeIMO
family.body: Export the same records to Excel, Word or PDF from your host application.

family.name: ConsoleMonster
family.body: Tables, trees and live dashboards in the console, for the same data at a prompt.
